meta.title: Styleguide
meta.description: Colour, type, space, motion and components for the NO TIME Creative House website.

intro.lead: Colour, type, space, motion and the components built from them. Every page of the site is assembled from what is on this one.

colour.selected: {hex} is selected. Copy it with your keyboard.

espresso.name: Deep Espresso
espresso.role: Dark section backgrounds, primary text on light.

cocoa.name: Cocoa Brown
cocoa.role: Secondary text and hover states on light.

champagne.name: Champagne Beige
champagne.role: Primary buttons and highlights on dark.

ivory.name: Vanilla Ivory
ivory.role: Light section backgrounds, text on dark.

type.headingKey: Bold for the word that matters.

samples.lead: From the first concept sketch to the last guest leaving, one team carries the idea, so nothing is lost between suppliers.
samples.body: Body copy stays calm and readable. Lines are held near 65 characters, and Arabic is set one step larger, so both languages carry the same visual weight on the page.

shape.radiusNote: 4px is the default for buttons, cards and fields. Tags use 2px.

micro.name: Micro
micro.desc: Buttons, links and toggles. Owned by Motion.

base.name: Base
base.desc: Section and card reveals. Owned by GSAP.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.desc: The gap between letters or words in a reveal.

components.link: Text link with an underline that draws in
components.labelsNote: “Illustrative” sits on any AI image that stands in for a real project. “Preview” marks concept screens of products still in development.
components.emailError: Add the domain after the @, for example {example}
components.categoriesNote: On a computer, a card opens when you hover over it or tab to it. On a phone, the card in view opens as you scroll.

closing.body: Every section of the site will be assembled from the colours, type, spacing and motion on this page.
